dialogue.polen.memory.first_flower: These flowers... Befsh used to say they helped me breathe when everything became too loud.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_hive: Bees always find their way back. I like to think I might, too.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_source: That energy... I feel like I should recognize it.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_colony: You're not building just to spend the night, are you?
dialogue.polen.memory.first_residence: This place... it does not feel borrowed anymore. It reminds me that a shelter can also become a promise.
